ev.q: Three programs identified nine cases among children in three centers
Seven of eight Head Start programs, representing 55 centers, responded to the survey.
Three programs identified nine cases among children in three centers
Five programs reported increasing cleaning and disinfecting of bedding and improving ventilation.
All reported implementing SOPs and adjusting them
self-administered temperature checks upon arrival were most frequently reported for staff members
this qualitative descriptive analysis might not be generalizable beyond the participating Head Start programs
CDC conducted a mixed-methods study during September–October 2020

methods_quotes.q: The four-phase study design included reviews of standard operating procedures (SOPs) for COVID-19 mitigation
Interviews were conducted in September and October with program directors identified by the Office of Head Start in five states
